dedupe_keys.name: lithium ion battery cycling dataset at 1c 2c and 2 75c discharge rates

description: The EV Battery Research Team at Bandung Institute of Technology and partner universities publish cycling measurements from three commercial 1,800 mAh LFP 18650 cells. Tests ran from April to September 2025 at a controlled 30 degrees Celsius, with one cell assigned to each discharge rate of 1C, 2C and 2.75C. One-second CSV records contain timestamps, operating mode, voltage, current, capacity and energy. Charging uses 1C constant-current/constant-voltage operation; cycling spans full charge to 30 percent state of charge and ends at 70 percent capacity retention. The April 2026 Zenodo archive is free under CC BY 4.0. These observations can calibrate battery degradation simulations for storage or electric vehicles. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these experiments. The temperature column is a zero-filled placeholder, not measured temperature. One cell per rate limits separation of rate effects from cell variability. Payload integrity, uncertainty and model transfer were not independently tested.
